mapper.select: SELECT p.word_id FROM student_word_progress p INNER JOIN word_book_item wbi ON wbi.word_id = p.word_id AND wbi.book_id = #{bookId} WHERE p.student_id = #{studentId} AND p.class_id = #{classId} AND p.status IN ('NEW', 'LEARNING') ORDER BY wbi.week IS NULL, wbi.week ASC, wbi.unit_name IS NULL, wbi.unit_name ASC, wbi.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC
